mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate further monetary easing.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 9.5% for two consecutive months, it signals severe labor market distress that triggers risk-off sentiment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE has exceeded 9.5% for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings expectations rise.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS have increased for two consecutive months, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods when industrial production (INDPRO) shows a sustained recovery (rising for two consecutive months), it signals improving supply chain conditions and manufacturing activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO has risen for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC for the INDPRO trend is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A positive growth trend in real GDP (GDPC1) over the past quarter indicates expanding economic activity, which supports higher corporate profits and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 growth is positive, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 2.5%, it signals persistent inflation that may trigger premature monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL yoy exceeds 2.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment (PAYEMS) and increases in unemployment (UNRATE) indicate worsening labor market conditions, which trigger risk aversion and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises for two consecutive months, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a near-zero interest rate environment (FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.2%), the Federal Reserve's commitment to maintaining accommodative policy supports equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is ≤ 0.2%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.
